route_note: Take a Blue Mountains Line train from Sydney Central directly to Katoomba (about 2 hours), then a local bus or short taxi to Echo Point and Scenic World.
see: Echo Point lookout for the Three Sisters
tour_query: Blue Mountains day trip from Sydney

route_note: Catch a Western Line train from Central to Blacktown (about 45 minutes), then a local bus to the Featherdale Wildlife Park entrance.
see: Featherdale Wildlife Park koalas and kangaroos
tour_query: Featherdale Wildlife Park day trip from Sydney

route_note: Take the Manly Ferry from Circular Quay (about 30 minutes) straight to Manly Wharf, then walk or take a local bus to the beach.
see: Manly to Shelly Beach coastal path
tour_query: Manly ferry and beach day trip from Sydney

route_note: Take a T4 Eastern Suburbs train to Bondi Junction, then a local bus down to Bondi Beach.
tour_query: Bondi Beach and coastal walk day trip from Sydney

route_note: Take a train or bus to the Northern Beaches, then the L90 or 199 bus up the peninsula to Palm Beach.
see: Palm Beach and Barrenjoey Lighthouse walk
tour_query: Palm Beach day trip from Sydney
